messages:
erin: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 span-loss + bad-aggregation items. Dropping owners and short timelines. Edit if wrong.

alex: I can take span extractor backpressure. Quick mitigation = bump JVM + tune consumer concurrency; full fix = backpressure tokens + better batching.

maria: Aggregator double-count root cause: retried batch replaying same increments. Plan = dedupe key (trace,span,batch) + metric agg.dedupe.hits. PR inbound.

sam: ETL staging lag was caused by a bad partition rollout. Reverted; adding alert etl.partition.lag_95. Full config tweak tomorrow.

erin: Owners/timelines I wrote: A) span extractor mitigation -> alex -> EOD; full redesign -> 2026-04-07. B) aggregator dedupe PR -> maria -> PR by 2026-03-30, canary 2026-04-02. C) ETL partition tune -> sam -> finish 2026-03-25.

kevin: I'll be backup for alex this week. If alex is blocked, ping me.

ops-bot: deploy started by alex at 1834720205  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

alex: Staging looks stable so far. Heap pressure reduced and consumer lag dropped. Will monitor for one hour then promote to canary.

maria: PR opens in ~2h with dedupe cache + metrics. Adding tests for duplicate increments.

erin: Two additional actions: 1) add GC-pause regression in chaos-suite -> owner maria -> ETA: 2 weeks, 2) add weekly observability digest tile for agg.dedupe.hits, span.kv.misses, etl.lag_95 -> owner erin -> ETA: 1 week.

sam: Added runbook note for emergency partition reassign. Linking logs and postmortem snippet in the doc.

erin: I'll draft a short customer blurb for support: "We've mitigated the issues causing missing spans and aggregation drift; engineers deployed mitigations and are rolling fixes. Expect improved accuracy within 48 hours."

alex: Noted recurring pattern (Jan + Feb) 1 we should treat this as a class of regressions and add test coverage.

erin: Thanks everyone. Daily 15m check-ins at 09:15 for next 3 days to verify telemetry. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
